newsitem.title: USA: Star Resources continues diamond tests.
newsitem.headline: Star Resources continues diamond tests.

text.p: Star Resources Corp said on Tuesday that it has recovered 0.125 total carats of diamonds in one trench and 0.103 carats of diamonds in another trench of the five trenches it examined at the Crater of Diamonds State Park in Arkansas.

"The company still considers the Crater of Diamonds to have potential," Star Resources said in a statement. "The company believes that future results will lead to the recognition of the source of large gemstones that are known to exist in the pipe."
Star Resources said the deposit is "extremely heterogeneous" and that the test represents only a portion of the whole deposit.
Three of the largest U.S. diamonds of record have all been recovered at the park and had uncut weights of 40.23 carats, 35.25 carats and 17.86 carats, the company said.
The next diamond recovery will start around the first week in February 1997, Star Resources said.
